يلتقون (form VIII)
# يَلْتَقُونَ (yaltaqūna) /jal.ta.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# يُلْتَقَوْنَ (yultaqawna) /jul.ta.qaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
